about: Glosses and readings for this part, chosen for its text: gl/glx a word's gloss (by its base form, or by its n-th occurrence as key#n); rd/rdx furigana for its kanji; sf by the word as written; bf the base form shown in the looked-up list. See docs/reader/engine/analyzer.js, overrides.
